messages:
noah-sales: FYI acme escalated — during a partner dry run they hit intermittent 5xxs again when driving a short spike. Deal owner flagged as blocker. SE + ops please triage.

tia-se: Which codes / any req ids? Is it the same pattern as last week?

noah-sales: Customer captured: 
```
2026-04-10T14:03:21Z 503 Service Unavailable req=ch_aa12
2026-04-10T14:03:22Z 503 Service Unavailable req=ch_aa13
```
They said it was a 90s spike to 160 rps during a scripted demo.

sam-ops: change-bot pulled project acme-poc metrics in us-east-1. Observed: pool_available=0, queue_depth peaked 260, many requests expired after queue_timeout=30s => 504/503. Autoscaler started scale-up at +18s but nodes returned healthy ~78s later.

change-bot: LOGS: collected 25 entries for req=ch_aa12 -> enqueue -> queued_too_long -> queue_drop -> 503. Model=redwood-v1.

rachel-runtime: Two quick mitigations we can do now: 1) enable temporary routing fallback to redwood-v1-small (quant) when queue_depth>60, 2) enable burst_pool with a small token cap. Both are config flags and revertable.

tia-se: Customer turned off burst for cost controls. Sales OK to enable a capped burst for the demo?

noah-sales: They agreed to a capped burst of 5k tokens for the demo window only. Also asked whether we can guarantee zero 5xxs for the 30-min live demo.

sam-ops: We can't promise zero 5xxs, but we can make a best-effort. I'll enable burst_pool cap=5000 and add a fallback route now. Commands: 
```
infractl config set acme-poc burst_pool.enabled=true burst_pool.cap_tokens=5000
infractl routing add --project acme-poc --rule "queue_depth>60 => redwood-v1-small"
```
Applying now.

change-bot: CONFIG_APPLY: burst_pool.enabled=true cap_tokens=5000 by sam-ops at 2026-04-10T14:08:50Z

sam-ops: Routing rule added. Also bumped queue_timeout to 60s temporarily.

rachel-runtime: I'll also nudge autoscale params: scale_threshold=55 and warm_spare=1 for the demo window. That reduces spinup lag. Will roll back after.

tia-se: Please make sure to capture request_ids during the verification so we can show ACME the logs. Also add a short note in the POC doc about burst billing for visibility.

noah-sales: I'll update ACME: changes = burst cap 5k, routing fallback, longer queue timeout, autoscale tweak. They want a short run to validate — can we run a 5-minute staged ramp to 170 rps and paste results?

sam-ops: Kicking off verification run in 2m. Will post final metrics and any request ids.

change-bot: VERIFICATION: staged-ramp started at 2026-04-10T14:12:00Z by sam-ops

sam-ops: Verification results: 5m ramp to 170 rps. queue_depth max=72, no queue_drop observed, burst usage=4200 tokens (below cap). No 5xx returned during the window. Collected request ids: ch_bb21..ch_bb48 for sampling.

rachel-runtime: Looks good. Follow-up recommend: add prefix caching for repeated prompts, consider increasing warm_spare to 2 for the next live demo, and offer a Dedicated demo if they need guaranteed capacity.

tia-se: I'll prepare a short explainer for ACME about expected behaviors when autoscaler lags and what burst does. Also will attach a billing note about the burst cap.

noah-sales: Thanks team. I'll share the verification log with ACME and confirm the demo slot. If anything recurs, paste req ids here and we'll escalate to runtime oncall. :thumbsup:
